title: CustExpIntlTransfSetup - Data API
description: Stores information for different data sources that are processed for customer insights. This object is available in API version 65.0 and later.

DataSourceChannelName.description: The name of the associated communication channel, such as Web, Email, Chat, or Voice.

DataSourceChannelType.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
DataSourceChannelType.description: Specifies the channel type as standard or custom. Possible values are: Custom Standard The default value is Standard.

IsDataProcessingPaused.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsDataProcessingPaused.description: Indicates whether data processing for the channel is temporarily paused (true). Use this field to control channel operations without deactivating the channel. The default value is false.

IsEnabled.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsEnabled.description: Indicates whether the channel is active for processing data (true). The default value is false.

LastReferencedDate.description: Date and time when the current user last viewed or modified this record, a record related to this record, or a list view. If this value is null, the current user has never viewed or modified a record related to this object.

LastViewedDate.description: Date and time when the current user last viewed or modified this record. If this value is null, the current user has never viewed or modified this record.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The name of the Customer Experience Intelligence Transformer Setup record.

ProcessingStartDate.description: The date to start processing data in the specified communication channel.
